record.body:
## Description

Make the tmux test harness (`tests/helpers.py`) load `se-workflow.tmux`. Delete `dashboard/tmux.conf`, the launcher test that reads it, and the `SE_WORKFLOW_DASHBOARD` assertion. Make `scripts/sync-plugin.sh` copy `se-workflow.tmux` into the install.

payload.title: Move the tmux tests and sync-plugin.sh to the script and delete tmux.conf

record.subject: tmux-conf-removal
